title: Nice Springy Mexican Peppers Chiles Rellenos
description: A comforting Mexican dish featuring roasted poblano peppers stuffed with a unique blend of flavors, including galangal and candy, all without eggs, making it friendly to those with dietary restrictions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roast the poblano peppers in the oven for about 30 minutes, or until the skin is charred and blistered.
Let the peppers cool down, then peel off the skin, remove the seeds, and cut a slit down one side of each pepper to create a pocket.
In a large skillet, sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic until they are softened.
Add the grated galangal and whole-grain mustard to the skillet and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the chopped candy and cook until it is well combined with the other ingredients.
Stuff each roasted poblano pepper with the galangal and candy mixture, followed by the shredded cheese.
Place the stuffed peppers in a baking dish and cover them with the tomato sauce.
Bake the peppers in the preheated oven for about 20 minutes, or until they are heated through and the cheese is melted.
